description: Grandi dighe is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartografia.servizirl.it. The database in question contains the information layer of the large dams, i.e. works of barrier height greater than 15 m, or resulting in a volume of reservoir greater than 1 million cubic meters (CIRC. M.LL.PP. 19 April 1995, No. 482), of State competence. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Large dams" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include dipartimento, piano soccorso rischio sismico, psrs, dighe, sbarramento, protezione civile. The listing shows 2017-11-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
